facts.fact: The GPE partnership compact, endorsed by the local education partners group, lists as a constraint the lack of articulation between the elements of the Ministry of Education's information system, so teacher access, workload and history data and school-materials requests cannot be fed or matched with SIGE data.

systems.system: Sistema Integrado de Gestão Escolar (SIGE / EMIS)
systems.owner: Ministério da Educação, Cultura e Ciências (MECC), with the World Bank

systems.system: Passaporte para a aprendizagem (national digital learning platform)

note: The compact says MECC and the World Bank are developing the EMIS/SIGE to link information between the central level and the districts; that is one system's tiers, not a link between education systems, so no underway fact.
